I live in a small apartment that doesn't have washer/dryer hookups, so this vent is just what I needed to install a small dryer. I shopped around quite a bit and didn't find a better price than this anywhere. It was easy to install so I had my dryer up and running in about 10 minutes.
The ventilation kit greatly improves the air circulation in my dryer. It dries faster!
The PVC material is extremely durable. It shows no signs of damage even with constant use.
We installed it immediately and it has helped us wash and dry laundry at anytime, super versatile and useful.
